structured.answer: I'd go with the "מניות" track (קופה 8522). It shows the biggest number on the page, "24.04%" over 3 years, the fee is the same as everything else, "0.55%", and it holds 7.3 billion so lots of people are in it. Honestly I came in thinking S&P 500, but that one only shows 13.7%.

stuck.where: Screen 2, choosing between the מניות row and the עוקב מדד S&P 500 row
stuck.why: I came for the S&P because that's what friends at work talk about, but מניות shows 24.04% next to 13.7%. I went with the bigger number and I'm not sure that was right.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the many rows that say 'פחות מ־3 שנים'
stuck.why: Most tracks show no return at all, just this text, so I couldn't compare them and ignored them.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the top of the page
stuck.why: The heading is just 'הראל' and there's no button to open anything, so I wasn't sure what the first step is.
The first rows ('אשראי ואג"ח', what looked like 'כללי') were half cut off between screens and I didn't go back to them.

findings.what: There's no next step. Nothing tells me how to open the fund or where to click to join.
findings.where: Whole page, especially the first screen

findings.what: Most rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return, so you can't compare them, and the few rows with numbers grab all the attention.
The fees are all about 0.55% and shown only in percent, so they look like nothing. I'd want to see shekels on my amount.
Too many similar tracks (16) and no hint which one fits a beginner
'מט"ח' and the ring charts aren't explained anywhere near them. I had to guess what yellow means.
The return is shown before fees, but the note saying so is tiny, so it's easy to miss
findings.where: Column header 'לפני דמי ניהול' and the grey note under the table

findings.what: The two fee lines (מההחיסכון / מההפקדות) are confusing
